name: smart-ai
description: SMART AI — psychology-driven personalized AI learning platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && concurrently -n core,web,worker -c yellow,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w packages/core" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:worker: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
